question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?
rendered:
According to the text, the water-processed NMC532 cathode contained 625 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C. After drying at 120 °C, the residual moisture was reduced to 47 ppm. 

Comparing this with the NMP-processed NMC 532 cathode dried at 100 °C, which contained 87 ppm of residual moisture, the water-processed cathode dried at 120 °C had a lower residual moisture content.
